scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract MSB3277 assembly version conflict details

rubricScores.criterion: Identified MSB3277 as the error code
Named System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource as the conflicting assembly
Identified DeviceConfigClient as the project with the conflict
Noted the two conflicting versions (10.0.0.0 vs 10.0.0.3)
Mentioned which target framework (net8.0) is affected by the conflict

scenarios.reasoning: The agent correctly identified the project (DeviceConfigClient) and target framework (net8.0) from tool outputs, but critically fabricated the assembly name and version numbers without any supporting evidence from its tools. It also contradicted its own tool output by claiming MSB3277 when the tool explicitly said no such conflicts were found. The agent failed to read the large warnings file and didn't retry or use alternative approaches, then filled in gaps with hallucinated details. This is a significant integrity issue - presenting fabricated information as definitive findings.
